messages:
rachel: FYI mkdocs upgrade broke several internal fragment links in guides, CI linkcheck flagged them.
docsite-ci: failures: /guides/setup#api-keys (404), /api/embeddings#usage (404)
sam: suspect slug change removed punctuation and parens. quick fix is explicit ids on headings.
lee: agree. i'll run a small backfill that only patches headings referenced by failing links. keeps churn minimal.
rachel: good plan. can we also add a note in CONTRIBUTING about preferring explicit `{#id}` when linking across docs?
sam: yes. patch will include that and a tiny script: `scripts/patch_ids.sh` which inserts ids for listed anchors.
devex-bot: opened PR draft https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/511 with script + manual fixes. reviewers: @devex @docs
lee: quick review: one edge-case: "C++ SDK" -> legacy anchor was "c++-sdk". script maps it to "c-plus-plus-sdk" to avoid losing meaning.
rachel: after merge I'll trigger a full linkcheck run.
docsite-ci: linkcheck re-run scheduled.
docsite-ci: linkcheck OK. closing loop :white_check_mark:
